# Traffic (generated, do not edit)

Read 2026-11-07T09:00 UTC from Cloudflare's edge analytics for freshcalendars.com, last 7 days (UTC days). Every page the edge served to a real browser counts, so these numbers are higher than Google Analytics, which misses ad-blocked visits and readers who leave before the page finishes loading. Self-declared bots are left out; unlabeled bots are not, and they are many: real search traffic is mostly mobile, so a desktop share far above half means bots and crawlers inflate these totals. Treat them as an upper bound and use the trend and the story ranking. Source: `scripts/news-traffic.mjs`, daily.

## Real readers (first-party beacon)

Page views sent by the reader's own browser to /api/pv when they leave the page (cloudflare/worker.js). Ad blockers do not stop it and bots that run no JavaScript never send it, so this is the number to report. Last 7 days.
